errors.text_span: 该线条在x=0处的起始数值约为71
errors.evidence: This part of the description refers to the PST (green) line. On the graph, the PST line starts at the highest F1 value, visibly above the Teacher line (which is around 71). The PST line's starting value is approximately 72 (the reference states 72.3). Stating the value is approximately 71 is incorrect and misrepresents the initial ranking of the methods.

This phrase describes the decline of the PST (green) line between x=0 and x=0.6. In this range, the F1 value drops from approximately 72 to 68. While this is a much slower decline compared to the other methods, calling a 4-point drop 'extremely weak' (极微弱) is an over-generalization.
